#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one independently prompted review; no retries or answer selection."""
import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--prompt", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--runner", type=Path, default=Path(
    "/Data/CascadeProjects/.worktrees/ab-contextual-answer-20260908/scripts/eval/contextual_memory_answer_trial.py"))
parser.add_argument("--codex", default="codex")
parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=180)
args = parser.parse_args()
if not 0 < args.timeout <= 180:
    parser.error("timeout must be > 0 and <= 180 seconds")
sys.path.insert(0, str(args.runner.resolve().parent))
import contextual_memory_answer_trial as trial

output = args.output.absolute()
prompt_bytes = args.prompt.read_bytes()
trial.fresh_directory(output)
(output / "prompt.txt").write_bytes(prompt_bytes)
manifest = {"phase": "independent_review", "status": "failed", "retries": 0,
            "requested_model": "gpt-6-astra", "requested_reasoning_effort": "medium",
            "source_sha256": {"prompt": trial.sha(output / "prompt.txt"),
                              "runner": trial.sha(args.runner), "driver": trial.sha(Path(__file__)),
                              "provider_feature_source": trial.sha(trial.FEATURE_SOURCE)},
            "disabled_features": trial.disabled_features()}
row = {"status": "failed", "timeout_seconds": args.timeout}
manifest["review"] = row
try:
    env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in trial.CODEX_ENV if key in os.environ}
    version = subprocess.run([args.codex, "--version"], env=env, capture_output=True,
                             text=True, timeout=10, check=False)
    manifest.update(cli_version=version.stdout.strip(), cli_version_exit=version.returncode,
                    cli_sha256=trial.sha(Path(shutil.which(args.codex) or args.codex).resolve()))
    (output / "cli-version.stderr").write_text(version.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ab-review-", dir="/var/tmp") as neutral:
        workspace = Path(neutral) / "workspace"
        workspace.mkdir()
        provider_answer = Path(neutral) / "answer.txt"
        command = trial.codex_command(args.codex, workspace, provider_answer)
        row.update(command=command, provider_workspace_initially_empty=not any(workspace.iterdir()))
        with (output / "stdout.jsonl").open("wb") as stdout, (output / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
            try:
                child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=workspace, env=env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                         stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
                try:
                    child.communicate(prompt_bytes, timeout=args.timeout)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    child.communicate()
                    row["timed_out"] = True
                row["exit_status"] = child.returncode
            except Exception as exc:
                row["error"] = str(exc)
            finally:
                row["elapsed_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
        (output / "answer.txt").write_bytes(provider_answer.read_bytes() if provider_answer.is_file() else b"")
    row["neutral_workspace_removed"] = not Path(neutral).exists()
    trial.classify_answer(output, row)
    manifest["status"] = row["status"]
except Exception as exc:
    manifest["error"] = str(exc)
finally:
    trial.write_json(output / "result.json", row)
    trial.finish(output, manifest)
print(manifest["status"])
raise SystemExit(0 if manifest["status"] == "complete" else 1)
